items.title: Previews look like your panes
items.text: The preview tiles beside the hero pane are small raised cards with clear edges, and the selected one is lit from behind like a focused pane.

items.title: Cmd-Shift-Up/Down stays in the window
items.text: In hero mode the chord steps through the current window's panes only, stops at the first and last pane, and does nothing over a single pane. It used to also jump to another window, in single-window mode as well.

items.title: The selected pane is never blank
items.text: A terminal picked in hero mode now always shows; it could come up empty and stop responding to the keys.

items.title: Minimized panes stay minimized when you click beside them
items.text: Clicking a link or anywhere in a web page next to a pane minimized into a blade no longer brings that pane back out.
